title: EDITOR’S NOTE on the Research Article “Mucus enhances gut homeostasis and oral tolerance by delivering immunoregulatory signals” | Science
description: On 25 October 2013, Science published the Research Article “Mucus enhances gut homeostasis and oral tolerance by delivering immunoregulatory signals” by Meimei Shan et al. (1). Comments on PubPeer (2) identified duplications within figure S20G and between figures S20B and s20G that were validated by Science and confirmed by the authors. The experimental work related to this paper was concluded in 2013, and the source data are no longer available. Science is posting this Editor’s Note to alert readers to these issues. We are not taking further action because the main conclusions of the paper remain supported.
